ترتهنون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَهِنُونَ (tartahinūna) /tar.ta.hi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# تُرْتَهَنُونَ (turtahanūna) /tur.ta.ha.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
